title: P1-F1 Worker-offloaded send/flush fanout A/B

phases.label: Dispatch synthetic send and offload derived fanout work to a dedicated Worker
Keep the page foreground-active after bounded projection commit

sop: F1 Worker B is an A/B solution test against the committed F0-D main-thread baseline.
F1 is not a renderer benchmark.
F1 must use the same F0-D structural workload and synthetic_pressure_multiplier=1.
Load the P1-F1 target and confirm visible audit state shows config_valid=true and capture_allowed=true.
Confirm worker_offload_enabled=true, worker_mode=dedicated-worker, equivalent_work_required=true, and no_precompute_before_click=true.
Confirm all F0-D structural config fields match the approved F0-D baseline.
Press Enter only after the page is loaded and Chrome is foreground-active.
Do not interact with the page during capture; the target dispatches synthetic DOM pointerup/click events on p0:capture:start.
The main thread must not synchronously wait for Worker completion.
Worker counters and checksum must prove equivalent work before any performance interpretation.
